title: Floating rails
description: Ever wanted a floating track of rails? This mod allows rails to float without blocks under them!
body:
### How to use this plugin:
1. Download the plugin
2. Upload it into the `Plugins` folder on your minecraft server!
3. Start the server and have fun!

### What does the plugin do:
* The plugin removes the requirement for any type of rail to have a support block
* Sadly you wont be able to directly place them without support blocks, as that is coded into the client, not the server
* So, Place a support block and place your rail ontop and break the support block and the rail will stay in place!
